verdict.rationale: Data region and residency selection is a fair question for a billing SaaS like Orb, but the evidence pack never documents choosing a storage region or residency. The closest item is managed daily exports to a destination of the customer's choice (orb-docs-12). That copies data outward and does not control where Orb itself stores data, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
